prompt: Give each product its own page at /products/<id> (the ids are in src/data.ts), with the product name as the heading, its price, its description, its specs as a list and an "Add to cart" button. Make each product name in the grid a link to its page. Keep it inside the single-page app with the existing router: no full page reloads, and the browser Back button returns to the grid. Write it in React, no new packages. Make reasonable assumptions where a detail is missing and finish the whole change without asking questions.
